**Reconstructed the #682 session tail — chain merged to tracker, slice 3 untouched, three issues awaiting signature**

**What**: Reconstructed from GitHub the tail of the 19→20/08 session that ended without a session summary (last engram record was the #749 review at 20:13 UTC; work continued until ~01:34 UTC on 20/08).

**State of #682 as of 2026-08-20**:
- The whole chain is MERGED into the tracker `feature/issue-682`: #736 #737 #739 #740 #741 #742 #747 #748 #749 #751 #753 (#744 closed unmerged). Tracker is 27 commits / 26 files / +2744 ahead of `origin/main` @ 46fb991. NO tracker→main PR exists yet. Zero open PRs.
- PR #751 corrected two false claims in the SDD artifacts; PR #753 closed the CHAIN review's blocker (APPROVE carrying escalate:human → now STOP by coherence rule) and the challenger-reaches-any-finding correction. Suite 4129/4129, three mutations killed.
- `openspec/changes/issue-682-independence-axis-ruling/tasks.md` (status: draft): slices 1 and 2 ticked (15 [x]); **slice 3 (transport ADR draft+promote, `same-model` runner, e2e through the real verb, cross-family explicitly out) fully unticked (6 [ ])**. REQ-682-5 has no task by design.
- Three issues filed from the loop, all `status:needs-review` (human must sign): **#750** (§10 inverted — APPROVE on uncomputable evidence, route is on main too), **#752** (a chained PR can never converge — the verdict judges the link, the chain ships), **#754** (no cold-reviewer role definition — every launch hand-writes the doctrine; maintainer asked for a generic prompt with dynamic parts).
- Worktree `/home/gandalf/IA/brain-issue-682` on `fix/issue-682-s2h-chain-review` has 17 untracked `.memory/records/*.jsonl` (engram→.memory sync never committed). Dozens of stale `.claude/worktrees/agent-*` review worktrees remain.

**Why**: The user asked to resume "the action plan" and the memory had a 5-hour hole.

**Learned**: A session that ends on a merge without `mem_session_summary` leaves the next one reconstructing from `gh pr list --state all`. The reconstruction worked because every PR body carried its own measurement census — the PR bodies were the memory.
